joseph-closer-to-an-end.subject: golden ember-glowing pocket watch
joseph-closer-to-an-end.color: warm amber gold with glowing ember-orange core

joseph-closer-to-an-end.prompt: an ethereal golden ember-glowing pocket watch made purely of light, large and filling most of the frame — its whole form traced by countless tiny glowing motes and hair-fine feathery wisps, translucent like luminous dust and mist with no solid surfaces, delicate fern-like filaments fraying outward, a gentle swirl of light around a softly glowing core, layered veils of light, long-exposure photograph of drifting light dust, warm amber gold with glowing ember-orange core, floating alone in deep black night
